text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One effective approach is using SMART goals, which means goals that are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to achieve. It is also important to define milestones and deliverables, so everyone can track progress and see results along the way. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters: make sure everyone involved agrees on the goals from the start. When these elements are in place, projects run more smoothly, and teams are more likely to reach their targets on time.
